evidence.claim: RDM Group ha sede a Milano e produce cartoncino per imballaggi di beni di consumo con 8 cartiere e 4 centri di taglio.
evidence.quote: The Headquarters are in Milan (Italy) but it has a strategic presence internationally thanks to its 8 mills (3 in Italy, 1 in Germany, 1 in Spain, 2 in the Netherlands and 1 in Sweden), 4 sheeting centres (2 in Italy, 1 in Spain and 1 in U.S.) and a active sales network worldwide || 8 mills (3 in Italy, 1 in Germany, 1 in Spain, 2 in the Netherlands and 1 in Sweden), 4 sheeting centres (2 in Italy, 1 in Spain and 1 in U.S.) || RDM Group cartonboard is mainly used as packaging for consumer goods (foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals, household appliances, cosmetics and personal care products), commercial displays and toys
